label: Respectful opening / appreciation toward the reviewer.
The rebuttal signals sincere engagement through detailed responses, length, added appendix content, or extensive explanation.
Concrete empirical evidence tied to reviewer concerns.
Demonstrating understanding and acknowledging valid points before responding.
Explicit cross-references to figures, tables, and sections by number.
Supplementary material and new visual evidence.
Going beyond the explicit ask and anticipating follow-ups.
Superficial or partial addressal of reviewer concerns.
Lack of quantitative/empirical evidence in rebuttal.
No new requested experiments / analyses / ablations / reviewer 'would-have-liked' checks.
Vague future-oriented promises instead of concrete commitments.
Incomplete empirical coverage even after rebuttal additions.
Unresolved quality-of-execution concerns, methodological or experimental design issues that additional experiments do not fix.
Silent acceptance of limitations with no mitigation.
Lack of structured rebuttal format, no explicit rebuttal section, no clear author-response markers, no point-by-point Q&A with reviewer quotes.
Section-referencing or paper-rephrasing instead of real clarification.
Inadequate explanation or persistent clarity issues.
Presentation or notation overload that worsens clarity.
No explicit commitment to revise or improve the paper.
Surfacing a previously unnoticed problem without proactive framing.
